item.title: Data visualization, music controllers and LDAP on Windows
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Data visualization, music controllers and LDAP on Windows
Three groups of links saved together in 2013: introductions to drawing charts with D3.js (with Python behind them) and Processing; two MIDI controllers and the software bundled with one of them; and three LDAP directory servers that run on a Windows development machine.

Data visualization

Data visualization with D3.js and python - part 1
Damian Kao’s blog Next Genetics (2012-03-22), first of three parts, subtitled “introduction to D3.js with a simple bar chart”.
